ImageDescription.value: This is an image of the Har Ki Dun valley in Garwhal Himalayas in the North Indian state of Uttarakhand. In this image, we can see a portion of the valley, a river which flows through it, and in the background, the himalyan peak called 'Swargarohini'. Local legend has it that Yudhishthira (one of the Pandava's from the Hindu composition called Mahabharata) scaled this peak on his way to Heaven.

ImageDescription.value:
Har Ki Dun Valley View - Sankri Range of Garhwal Himalayas, Uttarakhand, India.
Majestic Swargarohini Mountain and it's peak is visible on the right. Area of Juandhar Glacier is hidden behind the tall trees. Forest Guest House (with green tops) is visible in the lower left. Few trekkers are camping in their tents around the guest house. River visible in this photo originates from Manindar Taal.

ImageDescription.value: Har Ki Dun is located in Govind Pashu Vihar National Park and Sanctuary, which is a national park in Uttarakhand, India. It is accessible only by trekking of 35 kilometers. Trek route is dotted with local villages.For accomodation their is Forest rest Hour and  GMVN Rest House( can be booked online). This picture was actually taken on 26th December, which is typically an off-season  for the trekker.
